svg.title: RPA Agent · RA
svg.desc: Minimal RA thinking-person monogram: softened A crown, slightly heavier muted teal left stroke, and a smooth circular R bowl. Golden-ratio construction: canvas/construction height = phi; construction height/leg span = phi; construction height/stroke = phi^5; head diameter = construction height/phi; crown trim = stroke*phi. Phi=1.618033988749895.
